card.title: Keeping Score
card.instruction: Treat arrival times, effort, memory, and sacrifice as a running score you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I arrived ten minutes early to help set up. That's ten in my column.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stayed an hour late yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Evenings count differently. Mine required getting out of bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You live upstairs. I caught the six o'clock bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you were already up. I interrupted actual sleep. We need a separate column for sacrifice.
